renderer: Wildbound Chapter One web build (src/ow_core.js: resize(), project(), render())
projection: Perspective. The ground is one top-down texture drawn as a tilted plane, scanline by scanline. Standing art is upright billboards that always face the camera and scale with distance. No rotation, no orthographic or isometric view.

target_viewport.note: 480x270 internal at 16:9, integer-upscaled with nearest-neighbour; depth blur and vignette are applied on top.

billboard_behavior: Bottom-centre pivot on the ground at the object's tile. Drawn back to front by distance. Objects nearer the camera than the player fade out; buildings fade completely so they never cover the player.

native_pixel_to_world_scale.note: A human is about 27 world px tall, so a door opening of 39 native px (26.5 world px) reads as person-height.

what_the_camera_shows_of_a_building: Front face only. Roof tops, side walls and rear faces are never visible, so no extra roof/side/depth surfaces are needed for this camera.
lighting: Engine-side: time-of-day colour grade, soft blob shadows, night emissive pass for window glass and lamp glass, additive light pools, particles, depth-of-field bands, vignette. Source art must stay flat and evenly lit.
colour_grade_applied_to_pack_art: tools/build_data.py grade(): foliage greens pulled toward hue 118 with +22% saturation and +16% value; other colours +12% saturation, +6% value; outlines untouched.
ground: Painted procedurally by the engine (noise-shaded grass, curved dirt paths, cobble plaza, pond). The pack's 16x16 ground atlas is not used in this build.
